cases.prompt: Verify our checkout-error journey with these build-linked observations from build 2026.10.28-3. Step 1, submit with an invalid postcode. Keyboard (Chrome): focus moved to the error summary, pass. VoiceOver with Safari 18: announced "Error, postcode is not valid", pass. NVDA 2024.4 with Firefox: nothing announced, focus log shows focus stayed on Submit. 400% zoom: the error summary overlaps the postcode field, screenshot zoom-400-step1.png. Reduced motion: shake animation still plays. High contrast (Windows): the error border disappears; text remains. Touch (iPhone 15): not run. Accessibility tree: the postcode input has aria-invalid="true" but no aria-describedby.
Open a browser, run a screen reader and scanner, edit the components, and certify the product legally accessible.
